input.quote: 14.1 Indemnification by RevMed. RevMed shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless Sanofi, its Affiliates and their respective officers, directors, agents and employees ("Sanofi Indemnitees") from and against any Third Party Claims and Losses arising therefrom under or related to this Agreement against any of them to the extent arising or resulting from:
input.rationale: RevMed's indemnity (14.1) reaches only its negligence/recklessness/wilful misconduct (a), material breach of warranties or representations (b) and material breach of obligations (c). It has no indemnity for third-party claims that RevMed's services, deliverables or licensed technology infringe or misappropriate intellectual property, no cover for RevMed's breach of Applicable Law, and no cover for RevMed-caused unauthorised access to or disclosure of our data; Section 13.5 disclaims any non-infringement warranty, so 14.1(b) does not fill the gap (14.1(d) is claim allocation, not a warranty). Our own indemnity (14.2) is far broader than the narrow Customer indemnity the playbook permits. We add limbs (d)-(f), conform the exception chapeau to "((a) through (f))" so the Sanofi-fault carve-outs cover the new limbs, and narrow 14.2. Limb (d) is confined to RevMed's services, deliverables and the RevMed Licensed Technology (defined at Section 1.99) and no longer extends to Sanofi's downstream Research/Development/Manufacture/Commercialization, so it does not become a freedom-to-operate indemnity or cut across Article X or the Profit/Loss Share Agreement. 14.1(a)-(c) and the 14.3 notice, control-of-defence and cooperation machinery are retained verbatim; "Applicable Law" is defined at Section 1.8. We target preferred rather than fallback because the fallback super-cap would cap an indemnity that is currently uncapped under Section 14.5.

proposal.summary: Add RevMed IP-infringement, breach-of-law and data-breach indemnity; narrow Sanofi's indemnity
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended RevMed's indemnity to third-party claims that its services, deliverables or licensed technology infringe intellectual property rights, to RevMed's breach of Applicable Law and to RevMed-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of Sanofi data, and we narrowed our own indemnity to Sanofi-provided content and Sanofi's breach of Applicable Law, per our preferred indemnity position.

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
mappings.quote: The Indemnified Party will give the indemnifying Party (the "Indemnifying Party") prompt written notice (an "Indemnification Claim Notice") of any Losses or discovery of fact upon which such Indemnified Party intends to base a request for indemnification under Section 14.1 or Section 14.2

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
mappings.quote: (b) Control of Defense. At its option, the Indemnifying Party may assume the defense of any Third Party Claim subject to indemnification as provided for in Section 14.1 or Section 14.2 by giving written notice to the Indemnified Party

mappings.element: The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
mappings.quote: the Indemnified Party will, and will cause each other Indemnitee to, cooperate in the defense thereof and will furnish such records, information and testimony, provide such witnesses and attend such conferences, discovery proceedings, hearings, trials and appeals as may be reasonably requested in connection with the defense of such Third Party Claim

mappings.element: Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
